description: Ask what is actually known about an industry BEFORE researching it. Returns whether a curated value-chain map exists, whether SEC's SIC classification covers it, or neither -- with guidance for each case. SIC reaches every industry with a US filer; a curated map additionally carries chain position, non-US participants and demand drivers. Use this so a report never presents an uncurated participant list as if it were complete.
name: industry_coverage
title: Check Industry Coverage
